links.comparator_used: Direct concatenation of clinical notes in one combined prompt (M1)
links.outcome: Completeness and correctness of LLM-generated hospital course summaries (physician Likert ratings); conciseness also rated
links.effect: Completeness 4.28 ± 0.63 vs 4.01 ± 0.69 (p < 0.001); correctness 4.37 ± 0.54 vs 4.17 ± 0.57 (p = 0.002); conciseness no significant difference (p = 0.308)
links.quote: The summarize-then-prompt strategy outperformed direct concatenation strategy in both completeness (4.28 ± 0.63 vs. 4.01 ± 0.69, p < 0.001) and correctness (4.37 ± 0.54 vs. 4.17 ± 0.57, p = 0.002) of the summarization of the hospital course.
